instrument: East Whiteland Township data center zoning ordinance (Sept 24, 2026)
summary: Board of Supervisors voted unanimously to adopt a 32-page data center ordinance after a months-long moratorium; it does not affect the 1.5 million sq ft project under construction on the former Cyprus Foote Mineral site.
notes: Township used the Pennsylvania MPC 180-day curative-amendment pause (Center Square, May 8, 2026).
